info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Rail Operations API
info.description: The Payment Rail Operations API provides a comprehensive interface for managing payment rail operations within the financial ecosystem. It allows users to retrieve detailed information about various payment transactions and their statuses. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions, payment processors, and financial service providers who require real-time insights into payment operations. This API facilitates seamless tracking, reporting, and management of payment flows, ensuring that users can efficiently handle their payment processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the detailed operations related to payment rails, including their statuses and processed transactions. It is essential for monitoring and analysis of payment workflows.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve payment rail operation details. It should contain parameters necessary for fetching the desired payment rail information.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the payment rail operations.
